name: awesome-founder-kit
description: Founder Kit: a founder layer for building products with AI agents on top of oh-my-claudecode.

plugins.name: founder-kit
plugins.description: Founder layer on top of oh-my-claudecode: idea import, kickoff review, decisions as ADRs, project standards in drydock slots, conformance lens, brand system, process journal.

plugins.name: fk-practice-core
plugins.description: Cross-stack engineering practices: coding standards, API design, hexagonal architecture, error handling, ADRs, security checklist, search-first, verification reference, token hygiene.

plugins.name: fk-practice-web
plugins.description: Web stack practices: Node backend and frontend patterns, React, React testing, Playwright E2E, Postgres, Prisma, Redis, Docker, database migrations.

plugins.name: fk-practice-python
plugins.description: Python practices: idioms, pytest, Django patterns, Django security, Django testing, FastAPI.

plugins.name: fk-practice-go
plugins.description: Go practices: idiomatic patterns and testing.

plugins.name: fk-practice-jvm
plugins.description: JVM practices: Spring Boot patterns, security and testing; Kotlin patterns, coroutines/Flow and testing; Quarkus.

plugins.name: fk-practice-apple
plugins.description: Apple platform practices: SwiftUI, Swift 6.2 concurrency, actor-based persistence, protocol DI testing.

plugins.name: fk-practice-rust
plugins.description: Rust practices: idiomatic patterns and testing.

plugins.name: fk-practice-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET practices: C# and ASP.NET Core patterns, C# testing.

plugins.name: fk-practice-php
plugins.description: PHP practices: Laravel patterns, security and testing.

plugins.name: fk-practice-llm
plugins.description: LLM application practices: eval harness, cost-aware LLM pipelines, regression testing for AI-written code.
